name: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 6
source:
Even a prosperous world that has long been in existence can come to an end.

Heading towards the hospital to visit her grandmother, ordinary high school girl Takatsuka Azusa gets enticed by a mysterious voice, and ends up in a parallel world much like the Taishou Era through space-time travel.

The Imperial Capital, Tokyo.
It is a city in which new culture and ideologies, as well as old traditions, coexist with one another. In recent years, strange-looking beings dubbed as "Onryou" ran rampant. The Imperial Army formed an elite squad known as the "Onryou Subjugation Organisation", and maintained public order on a daily basis. However, the imperial capital's disorder continued to worsen. Amidst the growing numbers of the public circulating their fears and predictions of the ending of the world, Ryuujin's oracle was finally granted to them. Ryuujin's shrine maiden was then sought to be summoned.

In accordance to ceremony held by the Imperial Army, the one whom was summoned was none other than Azusa. However, not long after she alighted upon the parallel world, Azusa was invited and lead by a mysterious young man called "Darius" to go to the "Enchanted Forest", located to the west of the imperial capital. The young man freely admitted to being a demon, and sheltered her in his estate.

"Come, Miss Shrine Maiden of Ryuujin. Welcome to the dwelling of the demons."

The Imperial Army and the family of demons...

The two sides...

Azusa finds herself getting entangled within their dispute.

[Translation of the official website plot summary.]
translation:
即使是繁荣昌盛、延续已久的世界，也终有一天会迎来终结。

普通女高中生高冢 梓前往医院探望祖母时，被神秘声音吸引，通过时空旅行来到了一个与大正时代相似的平行世界。

帝都东京。
这是一座新文化、新思想与古老传统并存的城市。近年来，被称为“怨灵”的怪异生物横行。帝国军组建了名为“怨灵讨伐组织”的精锐部队，每天维持着公共秩序。然而，帝都的混乱仍在不断恶化。民众对世界末日的恐惧和预言越来越多，终于，他们得到了龙神的神谕，并试图召唤龙神的巫女。

按照帝国军举行的仪式，被召唤来的正是梓。然而，刚抵达这个平行世界不久，她便受到一名自称“达里乌斯”的神秘年轻男子邀请，在他的引导下前往帝都西方的“魔法森林”。这名年轻人坦率承认自己是恶魔，并让她住进自己的宅邸。

“来吧，龙神的巫女小姐。欢迎来到恶魔的居所。”

帝国军与恶魔一族……

双方……

梓发现自己被卷入了他们之间的争斗。

[译自官方网站剧情简介。]
